description: Literature review pack for a research topic: a staged reading list (foundation / core / frontier) with summaries, citation counts and links, the most-cited foundations, the recent frontier, papers per year, top venues, prolific authors, key terms, a short synthesis that cites only the listed papers (themes, open questions, where to start), next queries and a BibTeX file. Sources: arXiv, Crossref, DBLP, Europe PMC, OpenAlex. Needs a Quill Research Pass (1 USDC = 24 h, 5 USDC = 7 days, 15 USDC = 30 days by plain USDC transfer on Base; see payment_options), or pay per call over HTTP x402 ($0.25) at /v1/review.

field.description: auto (default) searches all indexes; cs = arXiv+DBLP+Crossref; bio = Europe PMC+Crossref; general = all except DBLP.

pass.description: Optional Quill Research Pass token (qp1...). Better: set it once as the MCP header Authorization: Bearer <token>.

since.description: Only papers published in or after this year (optional).

topic.description: Research topic, 1-10 content words (e.g. "graph neural networks drug discovery"). Omit for a demo.

name: literature_review
title: Literature review pack
